findings.description: S4.10 acceptance gate (end-to-end scenarios and golden dataset) is deferred to integration testing phase. The 6 planned scenarios (churn escalation, fraud override, low-confidence, SLA breach, multi-channel DND, proactive campaign) should be implemented before production deployment to validate the full escalation pipeline.
findings.suggestion: Add S4.10 E2E scenarios to integration test suite with 25-record golden dataset covering all 6 scenarios and their expected priority/routing outcomes.
